blocks.title: OpenAL 1.25.1 with 3D audio
blocks.tagline: Drop-in OpenAL replacement for TrackMania Forever with more voices and head-related audio.

items.title: HRTF
items.text: Native HRTF calibrated on a Neumann KU100.

items.title: Drop-in
items.text: Replaces OpenAL32.dll next to the game exe; the old one is backed up first.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: The package replaces `OpenAL32.dll` and adds `alsoft.ini` and the HRTF file `D1.mhr`. The launcher backs up the original DLL before replacing it.
